items.html: Also, just as the three [names] Yud-Hey-Vav in Hochma allude to the name SAG, as above, so too here in the throat there are six [names of] Ehyeh, which are two times SAG: one corresponding to Aba, and one corresponding to Ima. And just as the three [names] Yud-Hey-Vav in Hochma were alluded to in the palate, in the secret of the letters Gimel-Yud-Chaf-Kuf, as above, so too these [names of] Ehyeh included in the two supernal [names of] Ehyeh mentioned contain 42 twice, which equal in gematria Alef-Chet-Hey-Ayin, the letters of the throat.
